'''Tarrick''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was [[Assassination of Moff Tarrick|assassinated]] by a [[Pierce's black ops team|Imperial black ops unit]] under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pierce]] sometime before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="About" />
